_meta.convention: PR-v3 pure-prefill total throughput: max_new_tokens=1 per request (no decode tail), fresh nonce per request (no radix hit), /flush_cache between cells, total = sum(prompt_tokens of ok streams) / wall-clock (arm start -> last stream end). serialized=true means the engine's own running gauge never reached C: the cell ran under one-at-a-time admission and the figure is the wall-clock throughput of that policy.
